impressions.text: The change names OpenCode sessions with the repository and PR, keeps titles in sync after prompts and worker actions, and labels Claude worker prompts.
The worker reported passing formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, build, smoke, and other checks, and the orchestrator reported green CI and a successful live smoke.

The worker paused when CI reported an unrelated type clash in `src/gateway/server.ts`; the orchestrator attributed it to PRs #94 and #105 and directed the worker to wait for PR #117, then merge the updated dev branch and rerun checks.

roundCauses.text: CI was red because of a type clash between PRs #94 and #105, addressed by PR #117.
